usage: init_dpr.py [-h] [--variant {cbr_lif_dpr_v1,dpr_v1}] --source SOURCE
                   [--output OUTPUT] [--report REPORT] [--verify-existing]

DPR-1 controlled public initialization and actual nc=1 Trainer rebuild audit.
This entry never optimizes a model. Its train-entry audit stops immediately
after the native RTDETR.train -> Trainer.get_model reconstruction, before data
loading.

  --variant {cbr_lif_dpr_v1,dpr_v1}
  --source SOURCE
  --output OUTPUT
  --report REPORT
  --verify-existing     Reaudit an existing exact controlled init without
                        replacing it

usage: train_dpr.py [-h] [--variant {cbr_lif_dpr_v1,dpr_v1}] [--source SOURCE]
                    [--initialized INITIALIZED] [--data DATA]
                    [--report REPORT] [--checkpoint CHECKPOINT]
                    {environment,plan,verify,start,resume}

DPR formal training admission, unchanged parent recipe, and explicit resume.
Preflight never calls start. Formal start accepts only current, complete
server evidence. A completed training run is never silently restarted after
final val.

positional arguments:
  {environment,plan,verify,start,resume}

optional arguments:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --variant {cbr_lif_dpr_v1,dpr_v1}
  --source SOURCE
  --initialized INITIALIZED
  --data DATA
  --report REPORT
  --checkpoint CHECKPOINT

usage: preflight_dpr.py [-h] [--variant {cbr_lif_dpr_v1,dpr_v1}]
                        [--source SOURCE] [--initialized INITIALIZED]
                        [--data DATA] [--init-report INIT_REPORT]
                        [--math-report MATH_REPORT] [--output OUTPUT]
                        [--device {cpu,cuda,all}] [--capacity]
                        [--threads THREADS]

Bounded real-data DPR engineering checks; never starts formal training or
test. CPU/CUDA B2/160 lifecycle probes are distinct from native B16/640 AMP
capacity. Every invocation owns a fresh timestamp directory. Unknown checks
remain PENDING.

optional arguments:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --variant {cbr_lif_dpr_v1,dpr_v1}
  --source SOURCE
  --initialized INITIALIZED
  --data DATA
  --init-report INIT_REPORT
  --math-report MATH_REPORT
  --output OUTPUT
  --device {cpu,cuda,all}
  --capacity            Run original B16/640/AMP native training path, at most
                        16 batches
  --threads THREADS

usage: check_dpr.py [-h] [--variant {both,cbr_lif_dpr_v1,dpr_v1}] --output
                    OUTPUT [--imgsz IMGSZ] [--threads THREADS] [--math-only]

Bounded DPR mathematics/structure/deployment checks; never starts training or
test. Random model checks are explicitly not public-source initialization
evidence. Real detection-loss, native optimizer/resume and B16 CUDA evidence
belong to preflight.

optional arguments:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --variant {both,cbr_lif_dpr_v1,dpr_v1}
  --output OUTPUT
  --imgsz IMGSZ
  --threads THREADS
  --math-only

scope: Help only; no training or evaluation run

shell_checks.stdout:
Usage: bash tools/dpr_server.sh ACTION [tool arguments]
Actions: environment | init | init-preflight | plan | start | resume | val | test | pack
Set DPR_VARIANT=cbr_lif_dpr_v1 (default) or dpr_v1.
Set DPR_MAIN only to an explicitly verified equivalent main repository/data root.
init-preflight performs initialization, CPU mathematical/structure checks,
CPU/CUDA lifecycle checks, and native B16/640/AMP capacity (<=16 batches).
It never starts formal training, evaluation, or the other variant automatically.
resume requires --checkpoint PATH; val/test require --weights PATH (test also
requires --val-report PATH). pack forwards --run-dir/--output/--metadata.

routes.init-preflight: init plus preflight_dpr.py --variant --source --initialized --data --init-report --math-report --output --device all --capacity; train_dpr.py verify --report
routes.val/test: eval_dpr.py val/test --variant --data; caller supplies --weights and test --val-report; --launch supported
